newsitem.title: FINLAND: Benefon says close to GSM type approval.
newsitem.headline: Benefon says close to GSM type approval.

text.p: Finnish mobile phones maker Benefon Oy on Wednesday repeated it had not yet received type approval for its GSM handset, and no time frame could be given for the approval, although it was close.

"As we have indicated earlier, we are close to the type approval, but we don't know when it will be granted," Benefon CEO Jorma Nieminen told Reuters by telephone, when asked to comment on market talk that Benefon would soon launch its first and long expected GSM (Global System for Mobile Communication) product.
Nieminen said he did not know what was behind the sharp rise in Benefon shares, up 11 percent on Tuesday and seven percent or 6.50 markka on Wednesday to 93.50 markka by 1440/1240 GMT.
Benefon's final 1996 financial statement will be released on Friday and the type approval will be announced separately once it has been granted, he said.
He declined to estimate when a type approval was possible.
"As informed before, we will give a separate statement on the type approval when it has been granted," he said.
Benefon earlier reported a preliminary 32 million markka profit after financial items, down from 74 million in 1995.
